_meta.description: Candidate lists for every race in the Ontario municipalities in notes/councillor-election-structure.csv, keyed by StatCan census subdivision id.
_meta.provisional: Ontario nominations for the 2026 cycle close 2026-08-21 at 14:00, and the clerk's certified list follows by 16:00 on 2026-08-24. Every list here is an unofficial snapshot and is therefore incomplete - candidates may still file. Each municipality's collection date is its notes.retrieved: 2026-08-11 for all but North Bay and New Tecumseth, which joined the study on 2026-08-12. Markham, Vaughan and Waterloo each had only one mayoral candidate on file. Re-collect after certification for a final list.
_meta.schema: <census_id> -> {csdname, notes, races}. Each key under 'races' holds an ARRAY of race objects so a municipality with two races of the same type does not collapse: Sarnia has two at-large councillor races, and Chatham-Kent has two ward tiers with different max_votes. Race keys: mayor, atlarge, ward, 'regional councillor', 'deputy mayor'.
_meta.candidate_fields: name_raw is the name exactly as published. last_name is upper-cased and first_name mixed case, following data/csv/TEST_ab-cands.csv, so a middle name stays with the given name. Sources publish names in three different shapes ('Last, First', 'First Last', and mixed-case given name with a CAPS surname); the shape used for each municipality is its name_format in data/raw/by-municipality/. Only the 'First Last' shape has to be guessed at: there the surname boundary is found with nameparser plus a name corpus (names-dataset), which is what keeps multi-token surnames such as 'Del Duca' and 'Meed Ward' whole. Tokens that are common as both a given name and a surname are inherently undecidable and stay with the given name; the build lists those for review.
_meta.sources: district_source_url and max_votes_source are copied from notes/councillor-election-structure.csv for the matching race. candidate_list_url is the page the names were actually read from, which for many municipalities is one hop from district_source_url because that URL points at a ward-boundary or council-composition page rather than a candidate list.
_meta.withdrawn: Withdrawn nominations are excluded from this dataset.
_meta.excluded: Contests kept out of the study are listed in notes/excluded-races.csv and are absent from this file, candidates and all: Cambridge Councillor, Regional (5 candidates, upper_tier_only); Kitchener Councillor, Regional (11 candidates, upper_tier_only); Waterloo Councillor, Regional (4 candidates, upper_tier_only). 'upper_tier_only' means the seat sits on an upper-tier council rather than on that municipality's own, so it is not a race the study asks about; excluded-races.csv names the council in each case. The candidates are still collected in data/raw/by-municipality/, which stays a faithful record of what each city published.

notes.schema_note: Sarnia elects two distinct slates of four councillors city-wide, on separate ballot lines: 'Councillor, City' sits on city council only and is keyed 'atlarge'; 'Councillor, City-County' sits on Lambton County council as well and is keyed 'regional councillor', the same key every other upper-tier seat in the study uses.
